sourceContext.originPage: L'Oréal Groupe - Our Global Brands Portfolio page

contentPattern.structure: focus panel (background image + eyebrow + brand title + baseline + description + CTA) + division filter buttons + horizontally-looping logo carousel with prev/next navigation

suitableFor: filterable brand / logo showcases with a persistent focus panel highlighting one item
looping logo carousels navigated by prev/next arrows and filtered by category tabs
'Focus On' style brand spotlights combining a lifestyle background image with a scrolling logo strip
notSuitableFor: full-bleed multi-slide HERO banners with per-slide headline + single CTA (use carousel-hero)
simple horizontal portrait-card scrollers with a title + link per card (use cards-scroller)
static 2-4-up feature card grids with descriptions and CTAs (use cards-feature)
